summary: CDW Corp filed an 8-K (Items 2.02 and 8.01) to furnish its Q1 2026 earnings press release and announce a quarterly cash dividend of $0.63 per share payable June 10, 2026 to holders of record May 25, 2026. There is no merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. The filing is a routine current report on financial results and a standard dividend declaration, both ordinary course events with no special-situation catalyst. No deal terms exist; the dividend is a recurring capital return program.
